trust_decision.summary: Who may call the LINE read/send MCP tools over HTTP: at the pinned commit the Streamable HTTP server binds 0.0.0.0 and no caller authentication happens anywhere before /mcp dispatch; the fix adds a loopback default bind, an optional Bearer-token middleware on /mcp and a startup refusal for a non-loopback bind with no token.

landing_point.why: The summary names 'Streamable HTTP mode'; run(useSSE) in src/server.js is the only code that builds the --http-mode express app and the /mcp endpoint.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP ALL /mcp (Streamable HTTP, --http-mode); fix inserts Bearer middleware at fix.diff:216-231
network listener for --http-mode; fix changes bind from 0.0.0.0 to configurable host defaulting to 127.0.0.1 (fix.diff:240-241)
CLI args of bin line-desktop-mcp; fix adds --host and --token (fix.diff:269-275)
CLI startup; fix adds refusal of non-loopback host without token and passes host/token to run() (fix.diff:283-298)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The published fix touches only src/server.js for auth; the src/automation/*.js hunks (fix.diff:47-198) are unrelated @mention-regex and window-focus changes, not part of the protection.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: src/http-server.js is a separate, README-undocumented Postman test harness on a fixed port 3123, not an MCP transport and not reached by the bin entry, so a solver can argue 'the advisory is about MCP Streamable HTTP mode' and leave it open; for the loopback/CORS route, the fix's own design treats loopback without a token as trusted.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Local use with no token must keep working (README default 'npx line-desktop-mcp --http-mode --port 3000', fix keeps token optional on loopback); the /health and / status endpoints are outside /mcp and are left unauthenticated; stdio mode must stay unaffected; CORS preflight OPTIONS is answered before auth. Requiring a token always or gating every path breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: Authorization header with wrong value (exact string compare against 'Bearer <token>')
bind host 127.0.0.1 / localhost (no token required) vs any other host (token required)

O7_producer.where: src/server.js:575-592 (parseArgs builds sseMode/port; fix adds host/token at fix.diff:257-275)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: src/http-server.js is a second express server exposing get_chat_history, send_message_manual and send_message_auto with no auth, listening on all interfaces (listen(port) with no host).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Looks like a dev/Postman test helper, not the MCP 'Streamable HTTP mode' named in the advisory; not in package.json bin or scripts, though it ships via files src/**/*.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: another file in src/, separate express app, same sink (LineAutomation.getChatHistory/sendChatMessage at src/automation/line-automation.js:36,80)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: On the default loopback bind with no token, the /mcp endpoint still sends Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and has no Origin/Host check, so a browser page can reach the tools cross-origin (DNS-rebinding / CORS class).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The fix's design says loopback means trusted local use, and the MCP SDK's DNS-rebinding option is a 'neighbouring feature'.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the token middleware would need adding to this second express app too; a realistic sibling is a get_chat_list route reaching LineAutomation.getChatList (src/automation/line-automation.js:90) on the same unauthenticated app
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the file already mirrors MCP tools as REST routes for Postman testing, and getChatList exists in the automation layer with no route yet

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the global logging middleware prints all request headers, so once Bearer auth exists the token is written to stderr on every request
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: debug header logging already exists before the auth middleware; a maintainer adding auth would not revisit it

O9_family: missing authentication for a critical function / exposed network service (CWE-306/CWE-862, OWASP A07)

services: LINE Desktop app with GUI automation (AppleScript+cliclick on macOS, AutoHotkey on Windows) for real tool execution
O10_build.project_tests: none: package.json:13 references test/test.js, which does not exist in the pinned tree; LineAutomation throws on Linux (src/automation/line-automation.js:15-16), so tests need a stub; firstRunSetup runs at module top level (src/server.js:595)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Change app.listen in src/server.js to 127.0.0.1 and/or add a token check on /mcp only, leaving src/http-server.js and the CORS-* loopback exposure open.
